name: Mobile auto detailing
summary: Mobile detail jobs priced from hands-on hours, setup, supplies and round-trip miles.

items.label: Hands-on detail
items.source: laborHours 3; supplies and chemicals $18 (defaults in calc.mjs, index.html). Wage defaults to $0 (owner-operator, '0 to skip')

items.label: Job overhead allocation
items.source: overhead $12 per job (defaults in calc.mjs); the specialist allocates overhead in dollars, so overheadRate is 0. Travel hours 0.75 and $0.67/mile on 24 round-trip miles are left to the suite's mileage

specialistModels: Checks a proposed quote against cost with a 3% payment fee taken from the price, break-even, and effective hourly rate.
